ValidationRule.description: Requires Number_of_Users__c to be populated when Status is In Review, Approved, Rejected, Presented, Accepted, or Denied. Prevents users from saving the record without a value in Number of Users once it reaches these statuses. (before submit for approval)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Review"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Denied") ), ISBLANK(Number_of_Users__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Number of Users is required when before submitting the quote for approval
